nodes.name: Daily 7am
nodes.notes: Run this after Phase 1's ingestion run (6am) so today's and yesterday's prices are already cached - the priceAlerts job compares the two.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Use an admin account (see `npm run create-admin`). Only admins can trigger /admin/jobs/:name/run.

nodes.name: Get CSRF (run-job)
nodes.notes: Login rotates the CSRF cookie, so fetch a fresh matching token+cookie pair before the state-changing run-job call.

nodes.name: Run priceAlerts job
nodes.notes: This calls FarmFair's own priceAlerts logic (server/src/jobs/priceAlerts.ts) - the day-over-day threshold comparison and notification dispatch are unchanged; n8n is just the scheduler now instead of JOBS_ENABLED's in-process node-cron.
